title: Physical interpretation of the Gröbner--Shirshov energy: Hecke steps as crossing resolution
html:
Remark. Physical interpretation of the Gröbner--Shirshov energy: Hecke steps as crossing resolution

Remark (physical interpretation). The energy functional E(\mathcal{N}(Z, N)) gives the Skein binding energy of the nucleus. Each Hecke step resolves a double crossing into a weighted single crossing plus a resolved identity term. The factor (q - q^{-1}) acts as the crossing asymmetry. The Hecke reduction algebraically expresses the physical process of resolving a double crossing into its electromagnetic and strong components.
